five_day_thesis: Five sessions ago spot was $4,414 and it is $4,438.6 now (+$24.5), but that flat net move hides a failed breakout: price spiked to $4,539.2 on 09-04 and has bled $100.6 (-2.2%) in the three sessions since. Participation collapsed with it — call volume ran 14,671 on 09-04 and is 6,555 now, put volume 6,614 down to 2,403. The dealer long-gamma cushion is draining in step: window net GEX peaked at 711.7 on 09-04 and has decayed to 548.4 (-23%), while the sign has stayed positive all five days. Neither wall has moved a tick — put wall pinned at $3,500 (5,732) and call wall at $6,000 (18,802) for five straight sessions — and total OI has been frozen since 09-07, so this is a stalemate, not repositioning. ATM IV is up only 0.96pp over the window (22.73% to 23.69%) and unchanged for three sessions, confirming no one is paying up for a move.

prediction: Neutral to mildly bearish while spot holds under $4,500. Positive strike-level GEX of +233.6 within $200 of spot keeps dealers stabilizing, so the base case is a $4,372-$4,505 range (1sigma = $66, 1.49%) with rallies sold into the $4,500 call wall. A sustained break above $4,510 invalidates the fade and opens the $4,650 cumulative-GEX flip; below $4,372 the next real bid is the $4,300 put shelf (3,315 OI).
